Test_1_Test_Drive_vs_Conversion.null_hypothesis: H0: Taking a test drive has no association with customer lead conversion.
Test_1_Test_Drive_vs_Conversion.alternative_hypothesis: H1: Taking a test drive is significantly associated with customer lead conversion.
Test_1_Test_Drive_vs_Conversion.business_interpretation: Test drive completion has a statistically decisive relationship with conversion. Prospects taking test drives convert at more than 3x the baseline rate.

Test_2_Marketing_Channel_vs_Lead_Status.null_hypothesis: H0: Lead status distribution is independent of marketing channel touchpoints.
Test_2_Marketing_Channel_vs_Lead_Status.alternative_hypothesis: H1: Lead status distribution is significantly dependent on marketing channel touchpoints.
Test_2_Marketing_Channel_vs_Lead_Status.business_interpretation: High-intent inbound channels (Dealership Visits and Google Search) generate significantly higher proportion of conversions than passive broadcast channels.

Test_3_Website_Visits_T_Test.null_hypothesis: H0: Mean website visits do not differ between converted and non-converted leads.
Test_3_Website_Visits_T_Test.alternative_hypothesis: H1: Mean website visits are significantly higher for converted leads.
Test_3_Website_Visits_T_Test.business_interpretation: Converted leads averaged 7.8 website visits compared to 6.0 for non-converted leads. Website exploration strongly signifies purchase intent.

Test_4_EV_Model_Sales_ANOVA.null_hypothesis: H0: Mean realized sales revenue does not differ across Tata EV models.
Test_4_EV_Model_Sales_ANOVA.alternative_hypothesis: H1: Mean realized sales revenue differs significantly across Tata EV models.
Test_4_EV_Model_Sales_ANOVA.business_interpretation: Revenue realizations differ significantly across product segments, from entry-level Tiago EV to flagship Harrier EV.
